title: Figure 2 (20595): radar reflectivity overlay on Google Earth map near Santo sighting
description: Google Earth screen capture showing a NEXRAD composite reflectivity overlay (green, yellow and orange blocks) with a dBZ legend panel, roads and red track lines over Texas; part of the legend is redacted under (b)(3). Caption: "Figure 2 (20595) Orange block indicates an object at the place of the Santo sighting." Below is a highlighted witness account headed "20598 – Stephenville" describing two bright orange lights seen from a car near County Road 381.
